candidates.title: [Performance]: Quantize Humming per-token FP8 activations before AgRs dispatch
candidates.snippet: ### Proposal to improve performance  Humming indexed MoE experts currently defer dynamic per-token FP8 quantization until after AgRs gathers FP16/BF16 activations. Each receiving rank then quantizes the gathered rows before running the experts.  This causes two avoidable costs:  - AllGather transfers 16-bit activations even though the experts consume FP8. - The same activation rows are quantized separately on multiple receiving ranks.
